# Question 1
```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb.db")
listings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings")
```

```{r}
nrow(listings)
```


# Question 2
```{r}
columbus = listings[listings$city == "Columbus", ]
nrow(columbus)
```

# Question 3
```{r}
chicago = listings[listings$city == "Chicago", ]
which.max(chicago$price) # finds row with highest price
chicago$name[which.max(chicago$price)] # finds name of highest price row
```

# Question 4
```{r}
unique_neighbourhoods = unique(chicago$neighbourhood)
length(unique_neighbourhoods)
```
